title: Statistical Audit, Bayesian Diagnostics, and Reproducibility
paragraphs:
Appendix O
Statistical Audit, Bayesian Diagnostics, and
Reproducibility
This appendix holds the statistical audit conducted in the review workspace
alongside the thesis. Every block is marked FRESH (recomputed in this package
from versioned artifacts by a tracked Python script) or INHERITED (transcribed
verbatim from thesis exports and not re-run). The generator scripts, inputs, and
machine-readable outputs live under 04_statistical_audit of the review package;
their hashes are registered in the reproducibility manifest in Section O.4. No number
in this appendix was invented; each row names its source artifact or script.

The certicate transcribes the three blocks reproduced in Section 6.10: a fresh
SMC-ABC calibration, the parsed beta-binomial consensus model for SR', and the
inherited PyMC hierarchical model.
Within each block the distinction between
re-estimated and inherited is explicit, so the certicate cannot be mistaken for a
complete re-estimation.

O.3
Joint Display: Synthetic Agents Against Real Qualita-
tive Records
The GMM cluster-to-ground-truth joint display links each synthetic-agent cluster
in the frozen persona-s42 latent space to its nearest real qualitative records. It is
an audit artifact for future anchor selection, not a claim that the synthetic agents
are the real cases. Demo FGD/self-report records are never quoted; only non-demo
records carrying verbatim text are eligible as anchors, and quotes are excerpts rather
than consent-cleared full statements.

and 04_statistical_audit/reproducibility_manifest.py.

(they live on the gated Colab/Kaggle runners), and that no self-report ground-truth
export or Kaggle social-media wave is present as an artifact. Recording absence
is honest provenance; it prevents the manifest from being mistaken for a complete
run record. Reproducibility therefore means: running the frozen artifact hashes and
tracked generator scripts, not re-executing the external runners from this workspace.
